categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Copper Company Limited operates primarily in copper and gold mining, beneficiation, smelting, and processing. The company also engages in extraction and processing of rare and scattered metals, sulfur chemical products, and trading. It has a complete industrial chain covering exploration, mining, beneficiation, smelting, and processing, producing over 50 products including cathode copper, gold, silver, sulfuric acid, copper rods, tubes, and foils.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company mainly uses pyrometallurgical (fire refining) methods for copper smelting and hydrometallurgical (wet refining) methods for gold. It employs advanced technologies such as high-speed dispersion for flotation reagents, optical-electrical intelligent sorting, and 5G-enabled smart mining. The company also focuses on energy-saving, emission reduction, and digital transformation including intelligent manufacturing and digital mine construction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include copper processing enterprises, electronics, electrical, machinery manufacturing, construction, transportation, and defense industries. Major markets are domestic regions such as East China, South China, North China, and export markets including South Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and Hong Kong. Products like cathode copper and gold are traded on international exchanges such as the London Metal Exchange and Shanghai Futures Exchange.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with mining and smelting facilities located in Jiangxi Province and other provinces such as Shandong and Guangdong. It also has overseas investments and exports products internationally to Asia and other regions. Overseas assets account for approximately 17.88% of total assets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Copper is an integrated upstream to downstream operator in the copper industry, covering exploration, mining, beneficiation, smelting, refining, and downstream processing of copper and related metals. It also engages in sulfur chemical production and metal trading, positioning itself as a full-chain producer and supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in copper-based new materials, intelligent mining, safety technologies, and digital transformation. It emphasizes integration with national strategic technology needs, collaborative research with universities and institutes, and incentives for R&D personnel. Green development, energy efficiency, and digitalization are key strategic themes, alongside risk management and safety improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of copper cathodes, gold, silver, sulfuric acid, and copper processing products. Sales are conducted via direct sales, long-term contracts, and trading on futures exchanges. The company also earns income from investments and financial instruments related to commodity hedging.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangxi Copper is the largest copper producer in China and a leading integrated copper and precious metals producer. It holds a dominant position in the domestic market with significant scale advantages and a comprehensive industrial chain. Competitors include other major Chinese and international copper mining and smelting companies, but Jiangxi Copper maintains a leading role in scale, technology, and product breadth.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 521.9 billion, an 8.74% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 6.5 billion, up 8.53%. Total assets reached RMB 168.15 billion with a slight increase, while net assets decreased by 8.29%. The company shows steady growth in production volumes and financial performance, supported by capacity expansions and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangxi Copper offers a vertically integrated supply chain ensuring stable raw material supply and quality control. Its products, including LME and LBMA registered copper and precious metals, emphasize high purity and reliability. The company differentiates through advanced technology adoption, comprehensive product variety, strong R&D capabilities, and commitment to green and digital transformation, providing customers with high-quality, sustainable metal products.
